action.prompt: A detection rule file in src/detection/rules/ was created or changed. Create or update its matching <rule>.test.ts in the same folder. Cover what the rule flags, what it must not flag, and the exact start and end of each flagged span. Where the behaviour can be expressed as a property over generated input, add a fast-check property-based test with numRuns of at least 100 and a one-sentence comment above it stating the property. Do not edit any file other than that test file. Run npx vitest --run on the test file and make it pass.
